muxt explore-module

flags:
--format
  shorthand: ""
  type: string
  default: "text"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "output format (text or json)"
--verbose
  shorthand: "v"
  type: bool
  default: "false"
  hidden: false
  deprecated: ""
  usage: "verbose log output"

--help:
Lists every package in the module with a generated routes file: its generation flags, the muxt commands to run against it, and the external URLs its templates reference.

Full reference: muxt documentation docs/reference/commands/explore-module.md

Usage:
  muxt explore-module [flags]

Aliases:
  explore-module, explore

Flags:
      --format string   output format (text or json) (default "text")
  -h, --help            help for explore-module
  -v, --verbose         verbose log output

Global Flags:
  -C, --change-directory string   change the working directory
